definitions.explanation: Broadcasting video content in real-time over the internet.

examples.japanese: {今日|きょう}の{夜|よる}に{生配信|なまはいしん}します。
examples.english: I'll do a live stream tonight.

examples.japanese: {生配信|なまはいしん}を{見|み}ながらコメントした。
examples.english: I commented while watching the live stream.

examples.japanese: ゲームの{生配信|なまはいしん}が{人気|にんき}だ。

notes:
{生配信|なまはいしん} refers to broadcasting video content live over the internet. It is the standard term for internet live streaming in Japanese.

WORD FORMATION:
{生|なま} (live, raw) + {配信|はいしん} (streaming, distribution)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {生配信|なまはいしん}する: to live stream
- {生配信|なまはいしん}を{見|み}る: to watch a live stream
- ゲーム{生配信|なまはいしん}: game live stream

SYNONYMS:
- ライブ{配信|はいしん}: live streaming (synonym, uses English "live")
- {生放送|なまほうそう}: live broadcast (used more for TV/radio)

RELATED:
- {配信者|はいしんしゃ}: streamer, content distributor
- {配信|はいしん}: streaming/distribution (general, includes pre-recorded)
- {視聴者|しちょうしゃ}: viewer
